scope: Fail-closed, field-level publication guidance for malformed non-empty Media Library UUIDs in authored image, video poster, gallery and carousel content; invalidate the published asset cache token so the fixed Inspector code is loaded.

changes.manual_physical_acceptance: DEFERRED until complete Visual Editor scope
changes.follow_up_runtime_fix: Desktop and mobile Publish actions begin disabled until an Editor page is loaded; the storage browser regression waits for the loaded unpublished draft state before clicking. This prevents silent no-op publication attempts during initialization.

defect.before: Publication guidance treated any non-empty assetId as a valid media source, while the shared Editor/server validator accepts only a canonical Media Library UUID. For malformed saved values, the Inspector could show no guidance although Publish rejected the page.
defect.after: Asset IDs use the same UUID predicate as content validation; malformed IDs in image, video poster, gallery or carousel return actionable field guidance before source/alt checks. The server publication gate remains fail-closed.
